title: Rare-book theft ring and the burning of stolen books
place_text: New York / North America (US, Canada, Mexico)

tellings.quote: they were arrested for committing the largest rare book theft in America's history.

plain: Between about 1970 and 1973, people Peter Levenda knew in New York were, as he puts it, "arrested for committing the largest rare book theft in America's history," stealing rare books across the United States, Canada and Mexico, and some of the stolen books were burned. Levenda, an author presented on the show as a historian of the CIA, says he saw it from close by. He tells it as part of a wider tale of the strange occult circles he moved in as a young man.
